'''Fashaka''', better known as '''Fashaka Four-Toes''', was a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Notoriously riddled with disease, Fashaka worked with<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Doc (Knight)}}</ref> the [[xenopathologist]] and [[Doctor/Legends|combat surgeon]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]],<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> better known as "Doc," at one point during the crime lord's career.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fashaka was mentioned in the Codex entry for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] companion character Doc in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
